snippet.title: Cup of Tales Trailer
snippet.description:
Game details: https://www.eastasiasoft.com/games/Cup-of-Tales

Brew the perfect cup, get to know your customers and uncover a conspiracy brewing beneath the streets of futuristic London in Cup of Tales, a cosy visual novel adventure. Working alongside café owner Mia, you'll serve coffee, listen to the stories of the people who walk through the doors of Comfy Corner Café and help them through their everyday struggles. As the nights go by, these seemingly unrelated stories begin to reveal a much bigger mystery involving CypherCorp, the city's most powerful tech company.

Make dialogue choices, build meaningful relationships and bring a community of unlikely friends together. Brew coffee by selecting ingredients, using your equipment and timing your actions, then upgrade your kitchen to unlock new ingredients and recipes. Across 10 chapters, follow a colorful cast of characters as their stories intertwine, uncover strange clues and slowly reveal the truth behind what's happening in the city. Can a little café, a good cup of coffee and a group of unlikely friends make a difference?
